description: Read the advisory strategy and KPI context an operator has recorded for one brand (the brand slug from brands.json). Use this before producing a report so a delta can be judged against the client's own plan rather than reported bare. Returns { brand, orphan, strategy:{present,markdown}, kpi:{present,version,targets,parseErrors} }; targets are already parsed, parseErrors must be reported and excluded from verdicts, and the context is advisory only and never authorises a write.
name: affiliate_get_client_strategy
